compositionIntent: Viewer stands inside the location. Separate near left/right props frame an open combat center; props are not tiny distant settlement landmarks. Source PNGs retain complete silhouettes. Viewport-edge cropping of near framing props is intentional and must be explicit in scene JSON.

rules.backdrop: Opaque wide3072x1728 requested. Ground-level view with side framing and depth. No characters, text or large blocking object in central40%.
rules.ground: Transparent upper52–55%; opaque bottom plane extends fully to left/right/bottom edges. Shallow ground-level perspective and quiet combat center. Wide3072x1728 requested. Floor materials only: no buildings, walls, columns, fences, furniture, fixtures, torches or standing trees. Those belong in prop layers.
rules.prop-left: One complete transparent near-side framing prop, near-frontal mild3quarter view toward street center on RIGHT. Request1536square, object central75%, generous alpha margins, fully visible and no terrain slab.
rules.prop-right: One complete transparent near-side framing prop, near-frontal mild3quarter view toward street center on LEFT. Request1536square, object central75%, generous alpha margins, fully visible and no terrain slab.
rules.night: Dedicated painted night street layers with warm localized windows/lamps. No global tint-only replacement.
rules.interiors: No outdoor sky or precipitation in cave/dungeon interiors.
rules.overscan: Preserve peripheral painted space and complete source prop edges; requested resolution is not delivered resolution. Camera crop checks must distinguish intentional edge framing from accidental clipping.

uniqueSourcePolicy: Reuse records reference another setting/component ID in this batch. Reused PNGs are never copied or counted as new paintings.
